observations.body: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Elijah travels into the wilderness, sits down, and asks to die.
observations.label: Despair under a tree

observations.body: The wilderness isolates Elijah’s request to die before sleep, food, water, and renewed travel.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 19:2–6 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Care sustains Elijah while the cause of his despair is not resolved in this scene.
payload.title: Elijah under the broom tree
